reviewFindings: Direct reads remain preferred and never launch the helper on success.
Fallback is limited to EACCES/EPERM on the explicitly hosted GitHub Actions path.
The fixed absolute sudo/readlink argv uses the original observer PID, no shell, noninteractive mode and a five-second timeout.
Exit zero, empty stderr, exactly two syntactically valid namespace identities and unchanged original/fallback/after observer identity are all required before comparison with PID1.
Namespace inequality, malformed output, timeout, wrong runner context, other errno or identity change cannot set sameAsInit=true.
Original errno, command/result evidence and per-invocation elapsed time remain in raw snapshots; no successful result is cached.
The pre-admission raw quota observation is persisted before the unchanged quota assessor runs.
Workflow trigger additions only rerun the read-only environment observer on collection-source changes; request activation and workload/product files remain unchanged.
nonBlockingNotes: TimeoutExpired retains error type/message and elapsed time but not any partial stdout/stderr carried by that exception; this remains fail closed and cannot grant admission.
limits: This is source/evidence review, not independent re-execution of tests or the remote observer.
New VM evidence explains the observed permissions restriction on that diagnostic VM; it does not reconstruct the missing second-attempt snapshot.
The helper consumes observer and host resources, which must remain recorded; separate observer affinity is not proof of no perturbation.
This review grants zero benchmark duration or qualification and does not relax any quota, ancestry, noise or resource gate.
